ui_bugs.issue: After clicking the top-right 'Share Link' button the copyable share-box appears for one render then immediately disappears. Root cause: doShare() calls setShareInfo({url,...}) at line 117 THEN calls await reload(book.id) at line 119, and reload() unconditionally calls setShareInfo(null) at line 55. Result: data-testid='share-box', 'share-link-input', 'share-copy-btn', 'share-open-btn' are unreachable in the running app — the promised persistent copyable input never sticks. The clipboard copy still fires (from doShare) and the link IS saved to the Factory Library™, so functionality degrades gracefully, but the review spec's 'shown in a selectable input' contract is not met. FIX: either remove setShareInfo(null) from reload() (it belongs in selectBook only), OR call reload() BEFORE setShareInfo(), OR pass a flag to reload() to preserve shareInfo.

action_items: Fix share-box unmount race in /app/frontend/src/pages/BookManufacturing.js: either drop the setShareInfo(null) from reload() (line 55) so it only clears on selectBook, OR reorder doShare() to reload BEFORE setShareInfo, OR pass a keepShare flag. critical_code_review_comments: BookManufacturing.js:55 — reload() clears shareInfo on every book refetch. This is over-aggressive; the share modal should survive an in-place reload after a successful share. Same over-aggressiveness would also clear a proof toast state on any concurrent poll. Consider making reload() a pure data-refresh that never mutates ephemeral UI state.

book_manufacturing.py:311 — design() embeds the FIRST successful cover in the interior PDF regardless of which concept the Founder later selects. select_cover auto-runs sanitization_pass() which re-renders retail interior with the chosen cover — good — but the DESIGN artifact's paperback_interior_pdf still shows concept-1's cover on its label, which can confuse (design.print vs sanitization.retail_edition). Consider re-rendering the design.print PDF at select_cover time too, or removing design.print in favor of the sanitized retail edition.

book_manufacturing.py:325 — EPUB rendering exception is silently swallowed (except Exception: epub_url = None). Should log at minimum and surface a warning field in the design artifact so the Founder knows the EPUB was skipped.

book_manufacturing.py:145 — TYPO/SHADOW: `for pg in reader.pages` shadows the `pg` module import (product_governance imported as `pg` at line 22). Locally scoped so it works today, but a maintenance hazard. Rename the loop var.

kr_inheritance.py:59-63 — the OR chain now honors 'Verified' / 'Treasure Standard Approved' / verification.decision=='approve' / evidence_sufficient_for_external_publication / verified_external. Good, but the 'Verified' string is now case-sensitive; if a KR was ever stored with lowercased status it would be rejected. Consider .lower() comparison.

little_legacy.py:253-255 — an episode created from an unverified KR is stored to db.ll_episodes with status='Knowledge Required'. That's honest, but there's no delete/tombstone endpoint — over time db.ll_episodes will accumulate rejected drafts. Consider a purge or an ephemeral rejection response that doesn't insert.

rca of the issue: Share-box regression RCA: setShareInfo(null) is called inside reload() at BookManufacturing.js:55. doShare() sets shareInfo THEN awaits reload(), which nulls it out again. The Founder sees a 1-frame flash of the modal. Reproduction: log in as Founder → /book-manufacturing → select any book with a selected cover → click 'Share Link' → observe: (a) toast fires 'Share link created & copied', (b) Factory Library gains a new row, (c) the promised standalone share-box never sticks. Fix priority is HIGH because the review spec explicitly promises 'copyable share_url shown in a selectable input' — the Factory Library rows do provide that fallback but the primary UX contract is broken.
